Rule.name: HR Lifecycle - Status Attribute
Rule.Description:
Global rule for the "status" identity attribute. Runs on every identity refresh (with "Refresh identity attributes" ticked) and returns:
PreHire - today is before startDate Active - startDate <= today <= endDate (or no endDate) Terminated - today is after endDate Disabled - Emergency Disable is true (set by the "Emergency Identity Status Management Workflow"); overrides PreHire and Active
Precedence: Terminated, then Disabled, then PreHire / Active. A person whose end date has passed is Terminated even while Emergency Disable is true.
Dates come from the HR Authoritative CSV account (DD-MM-YYYY). Because it is recalculated on refresh, people move between states on the right day even when the CSV row itself has not changed.
